cause: TWO different faults wearing one symptom. On the DEFAULT engine the write is CORRECT — the stored parameter carries `SourceVariable { LocalVariable: "Name" }` — and the READER looked only at `SourceVariable.PageParameter`, found no `AttributeRef` beside it, and fell through to `<unbound>`. On the LEGACY engine the write really was wrong: it put every binding in `PageParameter`, ignoring the kind
insight: **Read the stored bytes before believing "silently dropped"** — half of this report was the tool disagreeing with itself, not with Mendix, and re-executing the describe output is what would have made it true. Studio Pro populates exactly one of `LocalVariable` / `PageParameter` / `SnippetParameter` on the same `Forms$PageVariable`; a local variable renders bare (`$Name`), the other two carry an `AttributeRef` and render `$Name.Attr`. **Two describers for one stored shape is the actual defect** — the pluggable one already read all three and the other did not, so they now share one resolver rather than being fixed twice.
